title: Genotype-free donor demultiplexing and donor count
conclusion: Without being told the donor count, Singlet finds the exact K in 6 of 6 held-out real pools (vireo with N = 12: 0 of 6); mean ARI 0.994 against 0.986 for vireo given the true K.
methods: Real pools only, each with truth from the data's authors: five Kang 2018 lupus PBMC lanes (true K = 8, 8, 8, 4, 4; labels are demuxlet calls made with donor genotypes), the MAESTER K562 + BT142 cell-line mixture (K = 2) and a single-patient bone marrow (K = 1). Reads were rebuilt from the submitted Cell Ranger BAMs (Kang) or downloaded (MAESTER), and every tool sees the same tagged BAM and the same called cells: Singlet is run once end to end (STAR alignment, cell calling, demultiplexing, K estimated by the held-out-likelihood search), and cellsnp-lite, vireo and souporcell are run on its BAM and cell list with the same 1000 Genomes SNP panel. Vireo has no K search, so its K is the number of donors holding at least 1% of cells when it is given N = 12 (the documented way to over-specify N); the rule was fixed before the runs. Vireo (3 seeds) and souporcell get the true K for the accuracy metrics. Scores are on truth singlets: ARI over all of them, with unassigned and doublet calls as their own labels; coverage is the fraction given a donor; per-donor recall uses Hungarian matching. The ARI tolerance is vireo's seed-to-seed standard deviation. The K metric is the fraction of held-out pools with the exact true K, gated at 0.9. The Kang batch 2 control lane is development data and is reported separately; it is excluded from the pooled numbers.

caveats: Truth for the Kang lanes is demuxlet's call, not an independent array; its own errors are in every number.

The Kang batch 2 control lane is development data (auto-K and the mt caller were developed on it in PR #36). The batch 2 IFN-beta lane has the same donors and chemistry and is therefore only a weak hold-out; the strict hold-outs are the batch 1 lanes and the MAESTER pools.
True K takes the values 1, 2, 4 and 8 only; K = 3, 5, 6, 7 and K > 8 have no real pool with truth in the cohort. No simulated or in-silico pools are used.

Vireo has no K-selection procedure. Its K here is a prune-by-size rule on an N = 12 run (donors with >= 1% of cells); other rules would give other numbers. Souporcell cannot estimate K and is only scored with the true K.
The BPDCN pool has one patient; any donor label other than one cluster counts against the tool, and homotypic doublets cannot be told from singlets by genotype.
Kang FASTQs were rebuilt from mapped primary alignments of Cell Ranger BAMs, so unmapped reads are missing.
